What to find: Main stages and methods of training (pretraining, SFT, preference optimisation/DPO, RL, distillation, merging).

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: Four stages on top of SmolLM3-3B: LoRA supervised fine-tuning on a synthetic formal-logic corpus; checkpoint fusion (parameter-space averaging of intermediate SFT checkpoints); WiSE-FT interpolation toward the base with λ = 0.25; and MGPO, entropy-weighted GRPO reinforcement learning against a programmatic verifier (published checkpoint step 2071).
quotes: Four stages on top of the base model:
1. **LoRA supervised fine-tuning** on a synthetic formal-logic corpus covering the Track A
